args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
Based on the working definition captured in prior knowledge — the "leading region" is the region whose customers placed the most orders — I joined `orders` to `customers` and counted orders per region. West leads with 339 orders, ahead of South (316), East (286), and North (259).

FINAL ANSWER: West
